contents.name: Inverse determinant line and holonomy of a smooth Dirac family

contents.name: Pfaffian lines and relative/invertible anomaly theory interface

source_review.read_extent: Read Lecture 11 §§11.1–11.2, PDF pp. 154–163, including the finite-dimensional Pfaffian-line construction, its Fredholm-family extension, and the anomaly/invertible-theory interface.
source_review.supports: A fermion partition function may be line-valued; a relative boundary theory pairs with an inverse bulk line. The lecture distinguishes this structural input from a scalar partition function.
source_review.limitations: The author explicitly says the lecture is long on story and short on details; §11.4 is identified as a thesis rather than a proved theorem and is not used here.
